float32HighestRayAgreement.method: Complete positive-overlap polygon vertices, identical Float32 source facets; independent barycentric/plane affine equations. MAX error is bounded by maximum per-face error. No claim of browser or GPU acceptance.

qualification: Existing highest-native-surface semantics only. Every overlapping face and height retained; measured inter-surface differences are not declared numerical noise. Per-node runtime budget and full terrain/source/neighbour/browser acceptance remain separate.
